title: Unit Review: Complex Conditionals, and Cortázar
goal: Review the strict, exception, deduction and warning conditions through a text about Julio Cortázar and Rayuela.
grammar: review of the complex conditionals, and a text about Julio Cortázar and Rayuela

items: I can read a short text about Julio Cortázar and his novel.
I can choose the connector for a strict condition, an exception or a warning.
I can tell *como* + subjunctive from *como* + indicative.
